policy_lock: T6 MUST NOT modify E0-E3 / C-states / ADD / HOLD / REDUCE / EXIT / P1-P3 parameters; no threshold search; no champion ranking; no confirmation-driven rule edits; no subgroup deletion on adverse results. T6 reads T3-T5 frozen products READ-ONLY.

segments.rule: development never enters formal confirmation claims; assignment is the frozen T5 split (never recomputed)

execution_reference.rationale: Daily Master keeps one row per (event, day); the P2-balanced direct_chase execution columns (_ref suffix) serve as the canonical reference path for mechanism studies. Other 11 cells remain available via t5_8_daily_exposure_pnl joins.

pit_rules.daily_master_forbidden: no column derived from t5_daily_outcome (fwd_*) may enter any T6 fact table; cum_ret_from_t0/drawdown_from_peak/max_dd_to_date/days_since_peak/efficiency/dist_ref* are path statistics known AT close of that day (PIT-legal)
pit_rules.stored_conventions: cum_ret_from_t0_log = log(close/close_T0); drawdown_from_peak_log and max_dd_to_date_log are stored as POSITIVE depth (post_t0_peak - cum); severe_dd thresholds therefore compare drawdown_from_peak_log >= 0.1053605 (NOT <= -0.105)
pit_rules.g3_verification: physical truncation replay: recompute cum_ret/drawdown/max_dd/days_since_peak from ret_1d_log prefix on sampled events; must equal stored values exactly (float tolerance 1e-12)

preregistered_thresholds._comment: ALL returns are LOG returns (signed). ALL drawdown depths are POSITIVE depth (post_t0_peak - cum; see pit_rules.stored_conventions). Comparison directions: ret <= large_loss_ret_log; drawdown_from_peak_log >= severe_dd_depth_log.
preregistered_thresholds.false_recovery_trigger: within 5 valid observations after ADD: lose_ref20_today OR drawdown_from_peak_log >= severe_dd_depth_log

capital_efficiency.capital_days_def: capital_days = sum over lifecycle of actual_exposure_day (actual = base * x)

eclass_metrics_prereg.forbidden: NO composite E-score may be created in T6

recycling_prereg.cycle_def: R0 = REDUCE day; A0 = first ADD after R0 in same lifecycle and same strategy branch; cycle = [R0, A0]; if REDUCE->EXIT next: FAILED_EXIT; if lifecycle ends before any ADD: NO_RECOVERY; if right-censored before resolution: CENSORED
recycling_prereg.repeated_reduce_rule: a second REDUCE before any ADD restarts the cycle clock (R0 moves); first-version taxonomy stays coarse on purpose
recycling_prereg.post_exit_lock_note: POST_EXIT_LOCKED is permanent (T5.8R-2): EXIT can never be followed by re-entry ADD

failure_stages.F1_initial_misclassification: first operator in {REDUCE, EXIT} occurs at delta_day <= quick_failure_day_window AND final ret <= 0 AND no healthy prefix (first-op day is the earliest structural signal)
failure_stages.F3_false_recovery: exists REDUCE->ADD cycle AND false_recovery_trigger fires within false_recovery_window_valid_obs valid observations after A0
failure_stages.F2_late_deterioration: days before first REDUCE >= healthy_prefix_days AND drawdown_from_peak_log at first-REDUCE day >= severe_dd_depth_log AND final ret <= 0
failure_stages.F4_exit_failure: max_dd_to_date_log >= exit_failure_dd_depth_log at some day AND no EXIT ever occurs AND final ret <= 0
failure_stages.F5_fast_failure_gap: a run of >= gap_rows_min consecutive row_present=False precedes terminal_reason=LIFECYCLE_END, OR single-day ret_1d_log <= large_loss_ret_log dominates the terminal leg
failure_stages.F6_censored_unclassifiable: censored episodes or none of F1-F5 matched

failure_anatomy_prereg.rule: classification code must be deterministic; NO manual judgement; thresholds are frozen BEFORE any T6.3 distribution is inspected

regime_prereg.sector_pit_constraint: T4 sector membership is a retrospective 2026 snapshot (NON-PIT). Sector analyses are EXPLORATORY ONLY and MUST NOT enter primary T6 conclusions. Gate-enforced.

statistics_prereg.multiple_comparison: Holm within each metric family (E-gradient adjacent comparisons)
statistics_prereg.primary_tests: validation + confirmation pooled report; development reference only

claim_rules: every formal report claim must cite a claim_id from t6_claim_registry.json; claims relying on non-PIT sector data are forced EXPLORATORY; tail-risk wording requires quantile/CVaR evidence (mean-only cannot claim tail protection)

gates_framework.G1_lineage: manifest inputs re-hashed vs sha256 (explicit list, no AST guessing)
gates_framework.G2_upstream_immutability: T3-T5 frozen product hashes recorded at T6.0 freeze; every later gate re-verifies
gates_framework.G3_pit_truncation_replay: physical prefix recompute == stored path stats on sampled events
gates_framework.G4_outcome_separation: fact tables contain no fwd_/future_/outcome_ columns AND their build lineage never reads t5_daily_outcome
gates_framework.G5_segment_isolation: segment values == frozen T5 assignment (no recompute, no leakage between splits)
gates_framework.G6_preregistration: every threshold/window/metric/classification used by run scripts must resolve from this contract file; hard-coded constants in stage code => FAIL
gates_framework.G7_no_tuning: source scan: grid/argmax/best/optimize/champion forbidden in T6 code
gates_framework.G8_conservation: population decompositions must sum exactly (cycles, failure stages, episode classes)
gates_framework.G9_statistical_integrity: cluster unit, seed, B, CI method, correction family verified against contract
gates_framework.G10_determinism: two full runs produce identical canonical hashes (sorted-frame, typed) of every parquet/json output
gates_framework.G11_anti_story: report claims subset of claim registry; forbidden phrases (tail protection w/o quantile evidence, sector in primary conclusions) machine-checked

stage_rule: each stage: code -> products -> gates -> report -> independent audit -> freeze commit; next stage may only read frozen prior stage
